output.brief: The rise is probably not a real deterioration caused by v4.18. The week of 26 Oct was 0.41%, below the normal-band upper edge of 0.48% computed from 26 prior weeks, and the burn rate was 0.82x, well under the 2x paging threshold. The dashboard recount matches the raw logs, so the measurement is not the problem. The "new pods error twice as often" pattern appeared in every recent rollout, including a config-only redeploy of the unchanged image, and matches a cache warm-up effect on new pods. So v4.18 is not shown to be the cause. Confidence is moderate: the replica host move and partner-sync month-end load are not yet ruled out, and I did not check the replica metrics or partner-sync run timing. Do not roll back, and do not mute alerting; the burn-rate page should stay on. Record the week as within normal at ops review and apply the standard weekly check. If next week exceeds the band or the burn page fires, open an investigation then, starting with replica metrics and partner-sync's run dates.
